name: Arrested Development
description: A wealthy family loses everything and one son has no choice but to keep them all together.
setting: Newport Beach and Sudden Valley, Orange County, California

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.premise: George Bluth Sr. is arrested for fraud at his retirement party and his son Michael must take over the family business while every other Bluth scrambles to protect their lifestyle.

episodes.title: Top Banana
episodes.premise: Michael puts George Michael in charge of the frozen banana stand to teach responsibility, not knowing his father has hidden evidence money in its walls — there's always money in the banana stand.

episodes.title: Charity Drive
episodes.premise: Lindsay tries to prove she's charitable by volunteering but keeps running into obstacles, while Michael discovers his company car was once used to transport undocumented workers.

episodes.title: Pier Pressure
episodes.premise: Michael tries to scare George Michael away from marijuana by staging an elaborate intervention using the family's go-to lesson-teaching method: hiring fake cops and gunfire.

episodes.title: Marta Complex
episodes.premise: Michael develops feelings for his brother Gob's girlfriend Marta while Gob remains oblivious, performing terrible magic shows and alienating everyone around him.

episodes.title: Whistler's Mother
episodes.premise: Lucille becomes an unlikely fugitive informant while Buster discovers his real father might be someone other than George Sr., destabilizing his already fragile sense of identity.

episodes.title: Let 'Em Eat Cake
episodes.premise: George Sr. escapes from prison as the family's legal troubles escalate, everyone turns on Michael, and the season ends with George fleeing to Mexico on Kitty's boat.

episodes.title: Amigos
episodes.premise: Michael, Gob, and Buster go to Mexico to find their father disguised in matching Three Amigos outfits, each believing they're the one George Sr. summoned.

episodes.title: Good Grief
episodes.premise: George Sr. fakes his death and the family holds a wake where no one is actually sad, Gob performs his worst illusion yet, and Michael becomes the prime suspect.

episodes.title: Afternoon Delight
episodes.premise: Michael and Maeby accidentally sing a sexually suggestive karaoke duet at the office Christmas party while Gob tries to fire everyone to assert his authority as CEO.

episodes.title: Burning Love
episodes.premise: Lucille throws a Valentine's Day party to make George Sr. jealous while Michael dates a blind attorney and Buster's hand gets bitten off by a loose seal.

episodes.title: Motherboy XXX
episodes.premise: Lucille enters Buster in a creepy mother-son dance competition called Motherboy, so Michael must rescue him while dealing with his own date who has a disturbingly close relationship with her son.

episodes.title: Meat the Veals
episodes.premise: George Michael plans to elope with Ann Veal, whose evangelical mother terrifies the Bluths, while Michael tries to stop the wedding and Gob accidentally seduces the wrong person.

episodes.title: Righteous Brothers
episodes.premise: The season finale brings all threads crashing together — the SEC closes in, Michael discovers his father's twin brother Oscar, and the stair car makes a fateful journey.

episodes.title: For British Eyes Only
episodes.premise: Michael travels to Wee Britain to investigate a mystery woman connected to his father's case, beginning a season-long arc of mistaken identities and British intrigue.

episodes.title: Mr. F
episodes.premise: Michael's British girlfriend may be a mole for the prosecution, Tobias is hired as a mole of a different kind, and a tiny town model is mistaken for a real Japanese development deal.

episodes.title: Prison Break-In
episodes.premise: The family launches an elaborate scheme to break into prison to steal evidence, echoing the show within a show that FOX keeps threatening to replace them with.

episodes.title: S.O.B.s
episodes.premise: The Bluths throw a 'Save Our Bluths' fundraiser in a meta-episode where the family tries to save themselves from cancellation, breaking the fourth wall about their ratings.

episodes.title: Family Ties
episodes.premise: Michael believes he's found his long-lost sister but Nellie turns out to be a prostitute hired by his father, while Maeby secretly runs a movie studio and greenlights everything.

episodes.title: Making a Stand
episodes.premise: Michael and Gob accidentally teach George Michael a violent lesson using J. Walter Weatherman's fake arm, perpetuating the family's dysfunctional cycle of traumatic 'lessons.'

episodes.title: Development Arrested
episodes.premise: Michael finally decides to leave the family for good and sail away with George Michael on the Queen Mary, while every Bluth secret unravels simultaneously in the courtroom.
